subject: POC runway: network & org handoffs, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering — final cadence
body:
Message 1 — 2025-10-15 09:12 Alicia Torres <alicia@medtech.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ops@medtech.io
Subject: Re: MAP draft & timeline — quick sync?

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the MAP draft. We reviewed the action items and want to lock down owner assignments for the POC environment so our security team can sign off. Our immediate asks:
- Confirm how API keys will be provisioned and rotated for the POC (who at Redwood issues them, expected TTL).
- Org-level setup: can we get a dedicated org with RBAC scoped for our trial?
- IP allowlist: we'll provide 3 CIDR blocks; we need a confirmation window for when the infra team will add them.
- VPC peering: we need estimated time-of-day for peering to schedule our firewall changes.

We are targeting a go/no-go decision by 2025-10-23 so would appreciate a firm cadence and any preflight docs you can attach.

Attaching our internal network diagram (network-requirements-2025-10.pdf).

Thanks,
Alicia
VP Engineering | MedTech Analytics

-----

Message 2 — 2025-10-15 10:05 Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@medtech.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Subject: Re: MAP draft & timeline — quick sync?

Alicia — thanks for the clear asks. High-level answers below and a proposed fast-run cadence:

Quick answers:
- API keys: I will provision scoped API keys for the POC org and hand them to your ops lead via the secure Doc (link below). Keys will be scoped to the trial project and have a 30-day TTL; we can extend by request. Rotation procedures: we will supply a key-rotation script and steps.
- Org setup: We can stand up a dedicated trial org (redwood-org-medtech-trial) with two RBAC roles: trial-admin (your ops) and trial-observer (your devs).
- IP allowlist: Send the CIDRs by EOD 10/16. Our infra team will schedule a 1-hour window to apply them on 10/18 between 02:00–04:00 PT (low-impact window).
- VPC peering: Estimated provisioning time is 6–8 hours after both sides exchange IDs and one round of firewall checks. We recommend scheduling peering on 10/19 morning PT.

Proposed cadence (short MAP addendum):
1) 10/16 — MedTech sends final CIDRs and confirmation of Peering VPC IDs.
2) 10/17 10:00 PT — 30m alignment call (Redwood infra + MedTech ops).
3) 10/18 02:00–04:00 PT — IP allowlist applied.
4) 10/19 morning — VPC peering performed and smoke tests run.
5) 10/23 — Go/no-go call and decision.

I attached a trimmed checklist (redwood_map_checklist_v1.xlsx) with owners. Ben and Jordan will pick up the infra steps — looping them now.

Link: DocuSign (POC agreement) — https://docusign.com/link/abc123-poc-agreement
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ RDW-2025-1489

Thanks — kim
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

-----

Message 3 — 2025-10-16 11:12 Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Subject: Re: MAP runway: network & org handoffs — infra tasks

Adding quick infra notes for the alignment call tomorrow:
- We need the MedTech VPC ID + ASN (if using private ASN) to draft the BGP plan; Alicia please include in your CIDR email.
- For IP allowlist: we will create the firewall rule, but MedTech must confirm that outbound connections on ports 443 and 5222 (internal telemetry) are allowed.
- Peering checklist: exchange peering request, accept, then run the routing verification steps in the checklist. Expect ~6 hours; will book 10/19 08:00–14:00 PT as buffer.

I'll attach the sample peering request payload during the call.

—Ben
Principal Cloud Ops Engineer | Redwood

-----

Message 4 — 2025-10-17 10:02 Alicia Torres <alicia@medtech.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ops@medtech.io
Subject: Re: MAP runway: network & org handoffs, API keys — CIDRs and VPC

Kim, Ben — sending the CIDRs and VPC details per plan. See below and attached.
- CIDRs: 34.201.120.0/24, 34.201.121.0/24, 10.45.32.0/24
- VPC ID: mt-analytics-prod-trial (VPC-0a1b2c3d), ASN: 65010

We confirm outbound ports 443 and 5222 are allowed for the test hosts. We are good for the 10/18 02:00–04:00 PT window. Ben — sample peering payload attached.

We've also countersigned the DocuSign POC agreement. DocuSign confirms signature — sending the envelope id: 0z9y8x.

Alicia

Attachment: medtech_vpc_and_peering.json (stub)

-----

Message 5 — 2025-10-20 15:03 Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@medtech.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Subject: Re: MAP runway: POC environment — status & next steps

Alicia — quick status update now that we've completed the steps:
- API keys: Provisioned and delivered to your ops lead via secure doc. Temporary keys issued (30d TTL). We included the rotation script in the attached checklist.
- Org: Trial org (redwood-org-medtech-trial) created; invited the two trial-admin users you listed.
- IP allowlist: Applied 10/18 at 02:12 PT.
- VPC peering: Completed 10/19 at 09:10 PT; routing verified and smoke tests passed (basic generation + embeddings).

Next:
- 10/23 09:00 PT — Go/no-go decision call. Please confirm attendees.
- If you want us to extend key TTL beyond 30 days after the POC, raise a support ticket referencing deal RDW-2025-1489.

Closing note: attaching the final checklist that shows owner sign-offs and the short runbook we executed (redwood_map_checklist_v1.xlsx).

Thanks and looking forward to the demo week.
Kim

Attachments referenced (stubs):
- redwood_map_checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — owners & runbook)
- network-requirements-2025-10.pdf (customer diagram — received)
- medtech_vpc_and_peering.json (customer-provided payload — stub)
